segments.title: Log into Nintendo with Google? That ends
segments.say: Do you log into your Nintendo Account with Google or Apple? Nintendo is ending that on January twenty sixth.

segments.title: No password? Set one now
segments.sub: Tap **Forgot your password?** to get one
segments.say: If you never made a password, go to the Nintendo Account sign in page and tap Forgot your password.

segments.title: Do this today
segments.say: Reset it, check your spam folder for the email, and add a passkey for faster sign in.

segments.title: Already signed in?
segments.sub: You may **not** need to log in again
segments.say: Already signed in on your Switch? You may not need to log in again. But do it before you're locked out.

segments.sub: to the friend with a Switch
segments.say: Send this to the friend with a Switch.
